title: Consistency of a track position
statement: Let $S$ be a list of segments, let $s$ be a segment index, and let $a,b\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Define a predicate on track positions by requiring the left boundary to have direction $b=\mathrm{false}$ and the right boundary to have direction $b=\mathrm{true}$. At a cell with parity $p$, require $p=a$ whenever the flag of segment $s$ is true.
